name: ThermaSol Ombra 4-5 Person Outdoor Sauna Cabin
description: Description Named after the Italian word for "shadow", the Ombra Sauna Cabin features reflective tinted glass creating a soft, ambient glow for the ideal private outdoor sanctuary. The semi-panoramic tempered bronze glass panels create a calming environment with a soft, ambient glow throughout the sauna's interior. Insulated with UV-protection, the glass preserves privacy while reducing heat transfer for energy efficient use. The remaining exterior walls feature fluted Tyrol wood wave accents, blending the cabins contemporary edge with a natural warmth. Engineered for all-season weatherproofed performance with built-in rainwater management and robust climate ratings, the Ombra is poised for long-lasting use. Entering the retreat, sauna enthusiasts are first met with a private dressing lounge, offering a transitional space to unwind before or after sessions. Brushed Tyrol wood walls offer an elegant contrast to the beautiful thermo-aspen benches and backrests, a feature carried over to the sauna. A frameless glass door separates the spaces, and upon entering you are greeted with floor-to-ceiling windows inviting in the surrounding landscape. Full-spectrum LED illumination compliments the interior ambiance while your Virta electric sauna heater creates rejuvenating heat and steam with the press of a touchpad. Supported by a 1-year warranty, the ThermaSol Ombra outdoor sauna is high-quality, fully equipped wellness escape perfect for bathing enthusiasts seeking the whole package. Features Pre-engineered cabin crafted from sustainably sourced materials blending beauty and practicality Fluted Tyrol wood exterior prized for durable outdoor use with a unique wave accent design All-season weatherproofed performance with multi-layer wood fiber insulation, a Firestone EPDM roof, and integrated rainwater management Parsol argon insulated tempered glass with UV-protection for enhanced safety, thermal efficiency and privacy Integrated private dressing lounge at the entry for a transitional space before or after sauna sessions. Harvia Virta electric sauna heater for powerful, evenly distributed heating performance Harvia Xenio sauna control touchpad to adjust time and temperature with repeat scheduling and WiFi connectivity through the MyHarvia App Full-spectrum recessed LED lighting with independent controls for a personalized ambiance Ideal for backyards, gardens and lakeside retreats Arrives fully assembled with pre-wired electrical for turnkey use Dimensions: 130"W (330.2 cm) x 89"D (226.1 cm) x 93"H (236.2 cm) Designed and crafted in the U.S.A. What's Included Pre-Assembled Sauna Cabin Harvia Virta 10.5kW Sauna Heater with Wi-Fi Harvia Xenio CX45 Digital Control with Wi-Fi Harvia AC3020 Sauna Stones (4) Temperature Sensor Headrest (2) Wood Platform MyHarvia App Installation Instructions Specifications Recommended capacity: 4-5 people Exterior (W × D × H): 130″ × 89″ × 93″ Heater: Harvia 10.5kW VIRTA Heater with Wi-Fi Sauna type: Traditional (Finnish) Installation: Outdoor, freestanding Lead time: Made to order, 12 weeks (plus 5–10 business days delivery) Shipping & Lead Time Freight is quoted separately for every order based on your delivery location and configuration. After you place your order, our team will contact you with your shipping quote before your build begins. Saunas are delivered fully assembled via flatbed trailer, and you'll be notified roughly two weeks before the scheduled delivery. A forklift or crane is required for placement, and a licensed electrician must connect the heater — manual offloading is not recommended. Documents Specification Sheet
